description: Baza danych szczegółowych osnów geodezyjnych (BDSOG), osnowa geodezyjna, powiat miński 1412 is a dataset listed in Geo-System metadata catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by powiatminski.pl. BDSOG - the database of detailed geodetic warps includes data and sets of observations and elaboration of the results of these observations, referring to the detailed warps established in the area of the relevant district. Coverage: PL. The portal shows the English title as "Database of detailed geodetic warps (BDSOG), geodetic warp, Minsk district 1412" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-podgik.
